items.title: Full Lamport clock with the receive rule, carried across the local integration boundaries (keeps the committed-step count)
items.summary:
## Decision (owner, 2026-10-24)

We need **both** of these:
- the count of **committed steps**, which never resets (what `lamport` counts today), and
- a **full Lamport clock** with the receive rule, **carried across the local integration boundaries**.

items.title: t19322: perf(pulse): raise worker-slot occupancy by decoupling dispatch from the Pulse instance lock
items.summary:
## Task


Worker slots sit idle more than half the time. Launches happen only while the process that holds the Pulse instance lock is in a dispatch round. Plan: measure, then give dispatch its own lock so a worker exit can start a replacement while the cycle runs maintenance, then remove the refill workarounds that existed only because of the shared lock.
